warnings.message: Poetry: installer.only-binary applies when packages are installed; poetry lock may still build source distributions to read their dependencies
warnings.fix: Run poetry lock where a build cannot reach secrets (CI or a container), and depcurfew doctor, which lists the packages in poetry.lock without a wheel

warnings.message: Poetry: installer.only-binary forbids building only packages from an index; Poetry still builds git, local directory and source archive dependencies
warnings.fix: Run depcurfew doctor to find them in the lockfile

warnings.message: Poetry: installer.no-binary lets docopt be built from source while building is forbidden for everything else; Poetry then always builds it from source, even where a wheel exists, because it has no setting that only allows building
warnings.fix: If pypi:docopt has a wheel and needs no build, remove it from installScripts.allow in depcurfew.json

warnings.message: Poetry has no setting for git dependencies, so "deny" cannot be enforced
warnings.fix: Run depcurfew doctor, which reports such dependencies in the lockfile

warnings.message: Poetry has no setting for URL dependencies, so "deny" cannot be enforced
warnings.fix: Run depcurfew doctor, which reports such dependencies in the lockfile
